campaign.name: Brooklyn Bridge — material and arrangement evidence
campaign.purpose: Close the open questions that documents could not. This model reached 45 passing tests with 12 placeholders left, and the survivors are not dimensional gaps that a better drawing would fill -- they are questions about what things are MADE OF and how they are ARRANGED, which is exactly what a photograph settles. Every material rule for the deck, the promenade and the stairs is graded D because no registered source says what the surfaces are. OQ-007 records that the approach supports are the wrong KIND of object. OQ-016 asks how the masonry above the saddle is arranged. A person reviewing openly-licensed photographs can answer all three; no amount of re-reading the 1877 report can.
